title: Hamburber Food
description: This mod adds a hamburber that grows on a vine and can be consumed for twice as much as golden carrots.
body:
![HAMBURBER!!!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5d2adc755f60fd6426b416eb045a0b156853ac41.png)
**This mod adds a hamburber that grows on a vine and can be consumed for twice as much as golden carrots. Can be crafted with 1x bread and 1x raw beef. This simple addition to your minecraft world or SMP allows a fun food source that adds spice too your world! **
